scope: static, AI-assisted, diff only, read-only, nothing executed; slot 14 proxy and DescriptorHeap read at the PR head
findings: Device slot 14 reads a console address and size from the 16 bytes after the PC heap description. With LEONIDA_CONSOLE_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP=1 that guest-supplied address becomes the heap's CPU pointer and descriptors are written there, with no check that the range is committed and writable or that console_size covers the descriptors.

This PR makes that path opt-in (it is unconditional on main), so it lowers exposure; validating the address and size is a hardening suggestion. Also pads the acphal context structs to their static_assert sizes. Not malicious.
